A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TIDE. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices are readable, allowing retained, relocated and removed material to be matched reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original classification results on four benchmarks, component ablations, localization analyses and test-time correction experiments, including appendix Table 3.

after.justification: V2 retains original benchmark results in Table 1, component ablations in Table 2, and correction and localization analyses.

M1.justification: The reported GPT-3.5 annotation prompt adds an explicit requirement for domain-agnostic features (v1 A.6 to v2 A.5), tightening concept-selection instructions. The architecture, losses, concept signatures and correction algorithm remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome and the same 40-class DomainNet subset with the same domains and classification tasks. Removing the CSA ablations does not alter dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in all four Table 1 comparisons. The qualitative ABA comparison in Figure 1 and NJPP comparison in appendix A.2 are also retained.

E3.justification: V2 removes the supplemental evaluation design measuring concept-map overlap across PACS targets after Photo training and testing a no-CSA control before and after correction. The main SSDG protocol, backbone, optimization settings and correction thresholds remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V1 A.5's two targeted ablations isolating CSA's contributions to localization and test-time correction are entirely removed. This substantially weakens the direct component analysis, although Table 2's incremental ablations, t-SNE analysis and signature-verification error cases remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-seed statistics, confidence intervals or significance tests. The retained results use the same domain-averaging practice.

E6.justification: Tables 1 and 2 retain their numerical results. V2 removes the supplemental CSA overlap scores of 0.19 without versus 0.71 with CSA, and Table 3's no-CSA mean accuracies of 73.61% before versus 28.10% after correction.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 retain the same concept-selection, loss and signature definitions. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: automated concept annotation, locally interpretable training and iterative test-time correction. The four-benchmark claim and approximately 12% average improvement claim remain unchanged.

C2.justification: V2 removes A.5's explanation that mislocalized concept maps can trigger correction on correct predictions and irreversibly mask useful regions. It adds the fur-versus-sketch example explaining domain-agnostic concept selection; the other signature-verification failure explanations remain.

D1.justification: The exact LLM prompt is revised to specify domain-agnostic features, with additional selection guidance in v2 A.5. The diffusion prompt template, example outputs and main implementation settings are retained; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

R1.justification: V2 adds Sivaprasad et al.'s Class-wise Domain Generalization work to the introduction and related-work motivation. Other reference changes largely update metadata for existing works, while the research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: The main narrative is largely unchanged. V2 moves references before the appendix, removes the additional-ablation subsection, renumbers prompting details from A.6 to A.5, and makes limited wording and bibliographic edits.

P2.justification: V2 removes Table 3, separates retained appendix Figures 10–11 from the bibliography, and makes small figure-sizing, label and caption adjustments. The main table structures and qualitative examples remain, with page-number footers removed.

improvement.justification: V2 clarifies concept prompting and separates references from appendix material, but removes the direct CSA localization validation and correction-failure analysis in v1 A.5/Table 3. With the headline claims and benchmark results unchanged, this loss reduces empirical support and explanatory completeness for a central component.
